title: Vivaer / RhinAer Setup
desc: MA setup checklist for Vivaer and RhinAer in-office radiofrequency procedures.

blocks.content: Critical first step: Confirm which procedure or combination is scheduled — Vivaer, RhinAer, or both. They require different wands. Do not assume.
Confirm correct disposable wand(s) are in stock: Vivaer wand and/or RhinAer wand. These are per-case cost items — no wand means the procedure cannot proceed
Confirm Aerin console is charged and powers on
Lidocaine-soaked pledgets prepared for topical anesthesia
1% or 2% lidocaine with epinephrine drawn for local injection
Place pledgets — start 10-minute timer before provider enters room
Patient seated in chair in comfortable reclined position
Saline spray beginning today, several times daily
Mild swelling and crusting for a few days — expected and normal
Full results take 4–6 weeks — advise patient not to judge outcome immediately
Schedule follow-up appointment before patient leaves
